notes: Fix: the rainbow 'custom colour' swatch was invisible on Safari. It used conic-gradient(from 0.25turn, …); some Safari builds drop that form, leaving a transparent (invisible) circle. Added a linear-gradient rainbow as a guaranteed-visible fallback (with conic still applied where supported), and the custom swatch now always shows the rainbow (a ring marks it when a custom colour is active) so it reads clearly as 'pick any colour' on both the Colour and Glow rows.
